items.summary: Security disposition: EVIDENCE_NEEDED fleet-wide; BLOCKED for security-sensitive releases and any new public exposure requiring unverified controls. Evidence: security baseline reports fleet-doctor unavailable with no run, operations deploy/uptime/error sweeps unavailable, and no direct evidence for authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, or disclosure readiness. No active vulnerability is established; the risk is high evidence uncertainty. TLS has no certificates expiring within 30 days, but this does not prove complete TLS coverage. Recommendation: continue existing read-only evidence work only, preserve private launch gates, and permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Do not claim certification or a clean bill of health.
